metadata.title: Structural studies on Multiferroic La1-xBixCrO3 Perovskites
metadata.summary: The authors made five La1-xBixCrO3 ceramics (x = 0 to 0.35) by solid-state reaction and studied their crystal structure with XRD and TEM. Rietveld refinement shows every sample is a single-phase orthorhombic perovskite (space group Pnma) with Bi on the La site. The lattice parameters and cell volume change non-monotonically with Bi content, which the authors attribute to the Bi3+ lone pair distorting Bi-O bonds and tilting the CrO6 octahedra. TEM/SAED on x = 0.3 confirms the Pnma cell.

systems.form: polycrystalline sintered pellet (bulk, inner cut surface)

precursors: Bi2O3 (99.99%, 5% excess to compensate Bi volatility)
conditions: 1 wt% PVA solution added as binder before pelletization
preheated 550 °C in air for 2 h (binder removal)
synthesis.notes: Pellets cut across the thickness; unreacted Bi2O3 found only on the bare upper surface, bulk is clean.

evidence.summary: Powder XRD of the inner cut (bulk) surfaces shows no unreacted Bi2O3; the bare upper pellet surface does contain unreacted Bi2O3.
conditions: measured on bare upper and inner cut surfaces
evidence.quote: The bulk was found free from unreacted Bi2O3.

evidence.summary: FullProf-2K Rietveld refinement starting from the reported LaCrO3 model with Bi placed on the La site; all peaks indexed by a single orthorhombic Pnma phase. Lattice parameters change non-monotonically with x.
conditions: starting model: LaCrO3 Wyckoff positions and lattice parameters from ref. [4]
evidence.quote: All the observed peaks were very nicely accounted by Pnma phase. We could not observe any un accounted peak.

evidence.summary: Trends vs Bi content: a increases up to x = 0.30 then drops at 0.35; b and cell volume decrease to x = 0.20, increase to 0.30, then drop abruptly; c decreases slowly to 0.30 and faster above. Attributed to anisotropic Bi-O bonds from the Bi3+ lone pair causing octahedral tilting (La3+ 1.32 Å and Bi3+ 1.30 Å radii are nearly equal).
evidence.quote: with increasing Bi3+ content the lattice parameters and cell volume undergo non monotonous changes

evidence.summary: A typical Rietveld fit is shown for x = 0.3.
evidence.quote: Fig.1 (b) represents a typical Rietveld refined XRD data for x=0.3.

evidence.summary: Bright-field TEM shows densely packed grains of about 1 µm.
evidence.quote: an electron micrograph of densely packed grains of sizes ~1µm

evidence.summary: Single-grain SAED patterns index to the orthorhombic Pnma phase along the [010] and [101] zones, confirming the XRD result.
conditions: selected-area diffraction from a single grain
evidence.quote: the SADs belong to the orthorhombic phase with lattice parameters a= 5.48Å, b= 7.76 Å & c= 5.49Å

evidence.summary: stacked powder XRD patterns: XRD patterns of all five compositions, vertically offset. Same set of perovskite reflections for every x, strongest near 2θ ≈ 32.5°; no extra peaks appear with Bi.
observations: No Bi2O3 or other impurity peaks visible
Pattern shape unchanged across x: same structure type
Legend labels x as 'Bi = 0.20%' etc. (means x = 0.20)

evidence.summary: Rietveld fit: Observed vs calculated pattern, Bragg positions and difference curve for x = 0.30. Difference curve is nearly flat, indicating a good single-phase Pnma fit.
observations: Flat difference curve, no unindexed peaks
No R-factors or chi² given in figure or text
evidence.quote: Fig.1.b. Reitveld refined XRD pattern of La0.70Bi0.30CrO3. All the cut pieces were studied using XRD with Cu-Kα in the 2θ range of 10°-110° using Rigaku

evidence.summary: lattice parameter a vs Bi content: a rises from ~5.480 Å (x=0) to a maximum ~5.492 Å at x=0.30, then drops to ~5.489 Å at x=0.35.
conditions: axes: Bi content (%), lattice parameter a (Å)
evidence.quote: Fig.2 (a-d). Variations of unit cell parameters and unit cell volume as a function of Bi content.

evidence.summary: lattice parameter b vs Bi content: b dips from ~7.761 to ~7.757 Å at x=0.20, rises to ~7.763 Å at x=0.30, then falls sharply to ~7.755 Å.
conditions: axes: Bi content (%), lattice parameter b (Å)
evidence.quote: Fig.2 (a-d). Variations of unit cell parameters and unit cell volume as a function of Bi content.

evidence.summary: lattice parameter c vs Bi content: c decreases from ~5.515 to ~5.495 Å by x=0.30, then faster to ~5.483 Å at x=0.35.
conditions: axes: Bi content (%), lattice parameter c (Å)
evidence.quote: Fig.2 (a-d). Variations of unit cell parameters and unit cell volume as a function of Bi content.

evidence.summary: unit cell volume vs Bi content: Volume dips to ~234.0 Å³ at x=0.20, recovers to ~234.3 at x=0.30, then drops abruptly to ~233.4 Å³.
conditions: axes: Bi content (%), unit cell volume (Å^3)
evidence.quote: Fig.2 (a-d). Variations of unit cell parameters and unit cell volume as a function of Bi content.

evidence.summary: bright-field TEM micrograph: Densely packed micron-sized grains with bend contours.
observations: Dense ceramic, no obvious secondary phase
evidence.quote: Fig.3. Microstructure (a) and SAD patterns taken along (b) [010], and (c) [101] zones of the orthorhombic Pnma phase of La0.70Bi0.30CrO3.

evidence.summary: SAED pattern: Single-crystal spot pattern along <010>.
observations: Rectangular net consistent with orthorhombic Pnma
evidence.quote: Fig.3. Microstructure (a) and SAD patterns taken along (b) [010], and (c) [101] zones of the orthorhombic Pnma phase of La0.70Bi0.30CrO3.

evidence.summary: SAED pattern: Single-crystal spot pattern along <101>.
evidence.quote: Fig.3. Microstructure (a) and SAD patterns taken along (b) [010], and (c) [101] zones of the orthorhombic Pnma phase of La0.70Bi0.30CrO3.
